title: LIDL: LLM Integration Defect Localization via Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Multi-Agent Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2601.05539v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-integrated software, which embeds or interacts with large language models (LLMs) as functional components, exhibits probabilistic and context-dependent behaviors that fundamentally differ from those of traditional software. This shift introduces a new category of integration defects that arise not only from code errors but also from misaligned interactions among LLM-specific artifacts, including prompts, API calls, configurations, and model outputs. However, existing defect localization techniques are ineffective at identifying these LLM-specific integration defects because they fail to capture cross-layer dependencies across heterogeneous artifacts, cannot exploit incomplete or misleading error traces, and lack semantic reasoning capabilities for identifying root causes. translated_title: LIDL：基于知识图谱增强的多智能体分析实现LLM集成缺陷定位
translated_abstract: 与大型语言模型（LLM）集成或交互的软件，即将LLM作为功能组件嵌入其中的软件，表现出与传统软件根本不同的概率性和上下文相关行为。这种转变引入了一类新的集成缺陷，这些缺陷不仅源于代码错误，还源于LLM特定制品（包括提示词、API调用、配置和模型输出）之间的交互失配。然而，现有的缺陷定位技术在识别这些LLM特定集成缺陷方面效果不佳，因为它们无法捕获跨异构制品的跨层依赖关系，无法利用不完整或具有误导性的错误轨迹，且缺乏识别根本原因所需的语义推理能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LIDL，一个用于LLM集成软件缺陷定位的多智能体框架。LIDL（1）构建了一个代码知识图……
tldr: LIDL提出了一种基于知识图谱增强的多智能体分析框架，用于定位LLM集成软件中因提示词、API调用、配置和模型输出等异构制品交互失配而产生的新型集成缺陷，克服了传统缺陷定位技术无法捕获跨层依赖和缺乏语义推理能力的局限。
en_tdlr: LIDL proposes a knowledge graph-enhanced multi-agent analysis framework that localizes novel integration defects in LLM-integrated software arising from misaligned interactions among heterogeneous artifacts such as prompts, API calls, configurations, and model outputs, overcoming the limitations of existing defect localization techniques in capturing cross-layer dependencies and performing semantic root-cause reasoning.
